description.text: This program could be taught both in English and Chinese. Master students could choose to be taught in Chinese or English language based on their own situation, and their degree dissertation could be chosen to be written in Chinese or English.

duration.text: The Industrial Economics at Wuhan University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7.photocopy of awards certificate If applicable 8.Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 9.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, who haven’t broken laws, are required to have bachelor degree.
